data.title: 刻俄柏 · 蘑菇图鉴
data.description: 她指着图鉴里颜色鲜亮的蘑菇问能不能吃，听完说明后认真记住了不能随便采。
data.promptProse: Curled up comfortably on a round woven carpet in a cozy corner of the library, Ceobe eagerly points a clawed finger at a colorful botanical illustration of forest mushrooms in a large hardcover encyclopedia. Towering bookshelves stacked with aged tomes surround her, while soft amber lamplight from a green banker's lamp casts warm reading illumination across the open pages.
data.animaCaption: Curled up on a woven carpet in a cozy library corner, she eagerly points a finger at bright mushroom illustrations in a large open encyclopedia. Warm amber glow from a green banker's lamp lights her wide-eyed curiosity.
